text: In a 2024 trial of veterans aged 60 and up, this therapy beat CBT: 63% had their pain drop by at least 30% afterward, compared to 17% with CBT. A 30% drop is a lower bar than getting your pain down to 0 or 1 out of 10, so the two trials' numbers can't be compared.
reader: an adult whose pain has lasted months with no injury or disease found to explain it, who came to the guide partly for that pain, deciding whether one of two pain therapies fits them, and which
